selected_evidence.requirement: Serve a successful HTTP response at `/` on TCP port 6700
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, Nginx was active and enabled, listening on IPv4 and IPv6 port 6700, and returned HTTP/1.1 200 OK with body `nginx on port 6700` through NODE_IP.

Healthy baseline boot ID d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6 was captured; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; the new boot ID 95008acf-800b-4af6-985f-acde8692b5a8 proved restart; post-restart checks confirmed Nginx, listener, firewall, SELinux policy, configuration, and HTTP response recovered.
